tldr: For finite ordinal potential outcomes with strictly positive identified margins, when is independence a sharp upper-harm law under mutual positive regression dependence and TP2, and which laws attain the bound? The proposed results give an explicit TP2 improving family for every invalid margin pair, classify strict and boundary optimizers, and give an exact arbitrary-margin ternary upper endpoint with attaining tables. The observable iff frontier remains a theorem that organizes these results; no priority claim is made for the bare criterion because the 1990 fixed-margin theorem text is unavailable. Conservative projection permits finite-sample reporting at its boundary and the ternary kinks.
